p:cNvPr.descr: The image is labeled "uracil" below. On the far left is the tautomer lactam, labeled below. It is a 6-sided ring with 2 NH and a single double bond with various substituents. The bottom NH bonds up and left to C, which double bonds down and left to O and up and right to NH. NH bonds up and right to C, which double bonds up to O and down and right to C, which double bonds down to C, which bonds down and left to NH. An equilibrium arrow to the right points to the tautomer lactim. It is a 6-sided ring with 1 NH, 1 N, and 2 double bonds with various substituents. The bottom NH bonds up and left to C, which double bonds down and left to O and up and right to N. N double bonds up and right to C, which bonds up to OH and down and right to C, which double bonds down to C, which bonds down and left to NH. An equilibrium arrow points right to the tautomer double lactim. This is a pyrimidine ring (6-sided ring with 2 N and 3 double bonds) with various substituents. The bottom N double bonds up and left to C, which bonds down and left to OH and up to N. N double bonds up and right to C, which single bonds up to OH and down & right to C, which double bonds down to C, which bonds down and left to N.
